subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A perfect photo can show faces.”?
options: An imperfect moment can hold a memory.
It can hold the memory of what a place once believed about itself.
Sometimes the nose opens memory faster than words.
It must also keep tone, habit, and memory.
